patterns_found.visual_evidence: The mobile sketch shows a compact header with a clear hamburger icon at the top right instead of visible full navigation links.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Tapping the hamburger should open and close a mobile navigation panel or drawer containing the site links. The trigger should reflect expanded/collapsed state.
patterns_found.ambiguities: The sketch does not show whether the menu opens as a full-screen overlay, side drawer, or dropdown panel.

patterns_found.visual_evidence: Because the mobile sketch includes a hamburger-triggered hidden navigation, opening that navigation implies keyboard focus must move into the revealed menu and return to the trigger when closed.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: When the mobile menu opens, focus should move to the first actionable item or close control; when it closes, focus should return to the hamburger button. If implemented as an overlay/drawer, background interaction should be constrained appropriately.
patterns_found.ambiguities: This depends on whether the menu is implemented as an overlay drawer versus an inline expansion.

patterns_found.visual_evidence: The desktop sketch includes a contact form with multiple text fields, a larger message area, and a submit button.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Submitting should validate required inputs, especially email and message if required, prevent invalid submission, and provide inline or adjacent error feedback plus success/failure handling.
patterns_found.ambiguities: Required fields are not explicitly marked in the sketch, so exact validation rules are inferred from the presence of a contact form.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply relatively light JavaScript overall: mobile primarily needs responsive navigation behavior via a hamburger-triggered menu, while desktop primarily needs contact-form submission and validation logic. The repeated image blocks in mobile and the hero/gallery/content sections in desktop appear static from the sketches alone, with no explicit evidence of carousels, tabs, accordions, modals, sticky behavior, or infinite loading.
